subject: Passing a data frame as a key to the reduce function

messages.author: bf77bb9e56ae890b
messages.subject: Passing a data frame as a key to the reduce function
parts:
Hello,
I am not sure about passing a data frame as a key to the reduce function. If the data frame contains a numeric variable and a factor variable, in the local backend it works, but it fails in the hadoop backend.
Any ideas?
Best regard
Emilio

rmr.options(backend="local")
rmr.options(backend="hadoop") # With this option, the following script fails

hiris <- to.dfs(iris)
hresult <-  mapreduce(input = hiris,
                      map = function(., v)
                      keyval(v[, c("Species","Sepal.Length")], 1),
                      reduce = function(k, vv) {
                        keyval(k, length(vv))
                      }
                      )

result <- from.dfs(hresult)
result

Can you also provide stderr of a failing task? I think the intro message says pretty clearly what good "error code 1" is from a debugging point of view. We need to know what went wrong, not that something went wrong. If that's all we know, I can offer my sympathies, but not much more.


Antonio
